name: relaycode
description: Mobile-first remote development control plane for local coding agents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @relaycode/protocol && npm run build -w @relaycode/mobile && npm run build -w @relaycode/bridge
scripts.dev: concurrently -n bridge,mobile -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @relaycode/bridge" "npm run dev -w @relaycode/mobile"
scripts.ios:generate: npm run ios:prepare && cd apps/ios && xcodegen generate
scripts.ios:build: npm run ios:generate && xcodebuild -project apps/ios/RelayCode.xcodeproj -scheme RelayCode -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @relaycode/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @relaycode/bridge && npm run typecheck -w @relaycode/mobile
